title: Fix CI failure: use workspace dependencies to avoid broken published packages
body:
CI tests failed with `Directory import '.../dist/types' is not supported` because some packages were pulling in published `@object-ui/core@0.3.1` which contains an invalid ES module export: `export * from './types'`.

## Changes

**Package dependency fixes:**
- `packages/plugin-form/package.json`: `@object-ui/data-objectstack` ^0.3.1 → workspace:*
- `packages/plugin-grid/package.json`: `@object-ui/data-objectstack` ^0.3.1 → workspace:*  
- `apps/console/package.json`: `@object-ui/layout` ^0.1.1 → workspace:*
- `pnpm-lock.yaml`: regenerated

## Context

The published `@object-ui/data-objectstack@0.3.1` depends on `@object-ui/core@0.3.1`, which has:
```js
// Published (broken)
export * from './types';  // Directory imports invalid in ES modules

// Workspace (correct)
export type { SchemaNode, ComponentRendererProps } from './types/index.js';
```

Using `workspace:*` ensures local versions are used, bypassing the broken published packages.
